about_the_game:
Shape Shapers is a fast-paced competitive puzzle game where quick thinking and geometric mastery determine who's the ultimate Shape Master!

Work alongside (or against) your friend in this quirky factory setting where you'll combine lines into increasingly complex shapes. Make a mistake, and the factory loses trust - sending you back to the basics. Can you maintain precision under pressure and outperform your rival?

Features

  • Competitive Multiplayer Action: Challenge your friend in intense head-to-head matches where speed and precision are key to victory.

  • Dynamic Shape Creation: Master the art of combining 6 unique line types to create an infinite variety of geometric patterns.

  • Progressive Challenge System: Start with simple shapes and work your way up to complex geometric masterpieces - but don't slip up, or it's back to basics!

  • Industrial Puzzle Environment: Experience shape-making mayhem amid a backdrop of conveyor belts and whirring machinery.

Shape Shapers includes:

  • 6 distinct line types for endless shape-crafting possibilities

  • Singleplayer mode to perfect your shape-making skills

  • Local and remote play multiplayer for intense 1v1 competition

  • Keyboard and Controller support

  • Achievement system to track your geometric mastery

Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate master of geometric manipulation? Join our factory workforce today and show your friend who's the real Shape Shaper!
